name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+13 district with incumbent Jared Huffman running
Huffman has over $1 million on hand; Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
No polls or expert ratings, but markets price near-certain Democratic win
model.rationale: Huffman is a well-funded incumbent in a D+13 district, while Robin Littau has shown no measurable fundraising or outside support, and prediction markets price the race at 99% Democratic. The fundamentals-based margin of roughly 22 points stands with no evidence to move it.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Huffman would be the first sign of a real contest, but none is currently visible.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
North Coast California's 2nd district leans Democratic by about 13 points, and incumbent Jared Huffman is seeking another term with more than $1 million in cash on hand. His Republican challenger, Robin Littau, has no reported fundraising and no outside groups active in the race on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, but prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 99%. With a strong incumbent, a favorable partisan lean, and a large financial advantage, the race is rated Safe Democratic.
